qualityNotes: Consistently ranked among the best healthcare systems in Europe. English widely spoken by medical staff. GP (huisarts) is the gatekeeper for specialist referrals.
pharmacyHours: Most pharmacies (apotheek) open Mon-Fri 8:30am-5:30pm. Duty pharmacies rotate for evenings/weekends — check apotheek.nl
pharmacyTips: Dutch pharmacies are well-organized but relatively strict. Many medications that are OTC elsewhere require a prescription here. The pharmacist will check interactions with your existing medications.
prescriptionRules: Stricter than many countries. Antibiotics, most allergy medications beyond basic antihistamines, and many pain relievers above ibuprofen require a prescription.

restrictedMeds.name: Pseudoephedrine
restrictedMeds.note: Not readily available OTC, prescription may be needed

restrictedMeds.name: Codeine
restrictedMeds.note: Prescription required for all codeine-containing products

restrictedMeds.name: ADHD medications (methylphenidate, amphetamines)
restrictedMeds.note: Bring original prescription and a doctor's letter

bringDocumentation: EU/EEA citizens: bring your EHIC card. All travelers: carry prescriptions with generic drug names in English. For controlled substances, a Schengen certificate from your doctor is recommended.

travelInsurance.requiredNote: Required for Schengen visa applicants (minimum €30,000 coverage)
travelInsurance.tips: Dutch healthcare is excellent but expensive without insurance. A GP visit costs ~€50-100, emergency room ~€300+. EU citizens can use EHIC for necessary care.

recommended: Hepatitis A (if visiting from endemic areas)
vaccinations.notes: No special vaccinations needed. The Netherlands has high routine vaccination coverage.

waterNotes: Tap water is excellent quality throughout the Netherlands — among the best in Europe. No chlorine is added (UV/ozone treatment instead).
foodSafetyTips: Very high food safety standards. Street food (herring, stroopwafels, frites) is safe. Raw herring is a traditional Dutch snack and is safe to eat.
sources: RIVM (Dutch National Institute for Public Health)
metaDescription: Complete health & medication guide for traveling to the Netherlands. Emergency numbers, pharmacy access, strict prescription rules, EHIC coverage, and travel insurance tips.
